messages.subject: what is "remove" column in FeatureLevelData
parts:
Dear MSstatsTeam

I've just stumbled over a column named "remove" in the FeatureLevelData dataframe of the dataProcess output. I wasn't able to find anything about this column in the documentation and deactivating all filter options during import (SpectronauttoMSstatsFormat) and dataProcess  did only marginally (-2%) change the TRUE/FALSE ratio in this column. Can you elaborate a bit on what this column is about? It is not correlating with the "censored" column.

I'm working with MSstats_4.6.3. Thank you for your explanations...

Best,
Christian

messages.author: 5c6e92c10ef28984
messages.subject: Re: what is "remove" column in FeatureLevelData
parts:
Hi,


this column is a result of using TopN feature selection option (or may exists for consistency if other options were used). "TRUE" in this column means feature won't be used for summarization.


Kind regards
Mateusz
